elements.label: Figure B3.1.1
elements.title: Key components of costs of conformity assessment from a firm's perspective
elements.content:
Meeting the standard: Quality upgrading (1):
- Purchase of standards
- Consultancy and advisory services
- Investment in upgrades (for example, IT systems, equipment, documentation, or higher wages)
- Internal staff time and training, including opportunity costs
- Corrective actions after conformity assessment

Demonstrating compliance: Conformity assessment (2):
- Testing (including preparing and shipping samples) or inspection
- Audit (initial and surveillance audits), including auditor time and travel
- Licensing fees
- Membership fees
- Longer lead times due to conformity assessment process (indirect cost)

Source: WDR 2025 team.
Note: IT = information technology.
